cc:Work.dc:description: Development 2020–24 · OOS-A signals in 2025 · OOS-B signals Feb–Jun 2026 · later burnoff completes positions Actual geometry beat controls in 6/18 and 9/18 cells. OOS-B failed its own gate; USTEC monetary parity was not certified.
